NONE blocking — all 4 iter-21 deltas (multi-tenant isolation, legacy backfill, integrations test/pull, BrandIcons) shipped correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: ws_filter() correctly handles legacy (ws_default) docs by matching either workspace_id==ws_default OR missing field — verified by owner@urbanflavours.ca seeing all 23 legacy interactions after backfill.
Integration /pull endpoint correctly calls test_connection() FIRST and 401s on bad creds before attempting pull — defensive and prevents partial inserts.
ZendeskConnector + IntercomConnector are clean, dependency-injected, and async — easy to mock for future unit tests.
PUT /api/settings uses SettingsIn which requires llm_provider+llm_model — frontend must always GET-then-PUT full body. Not a bug but worth a one-line comment for downstream API consumers.
ExecutiveView ExecKpi cleanly accepts iconName and renders BrandIcon — no Lucide imports leaked into KPI section. Delta uses pure CSS triangle (border trick) so no Lucide TrendingUp dependency.
